card.title: Samsung Galaxy A53 5G Network issue

claims.statement: Galaxy A53 5G flipping between 'Emergency calls only' and 'No service' is usually a failed APT IC near the CPU disrupting the VPA_APT network supply.
VPA_APT coil output should be 2.0–4.2 V (tracks battery); 0 V or fluctuating means repair.
Fix: replace the APT IC (183 °C paste), or remove the VPA_APT boost coil and jumper VPH_PWR to the VPA_APT output.

procedure: Check for shorts around network ICs.
Replace APT IC, or jumper VPH_PWR to VPA_APT.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
